title: 第22章 抓到个正着
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: “儿子，欠条打个勾，她就能认账？”王秀菊也是头一回听说。“嗯，她认，我认，就行了。打勾还是画圈，都不重要。”刘宇宁把‘条子’收进了裤袋。“条子给我保管吧，你出去上班，别到时候给忘记了，洗了水，五十块可就打水漂了。”“我自己保管，她跟我借的，我自己找她要。”刘宇宁扬起嘴角，把纸笔塞给王秀菊，然后也出了门。赵丁就是个混不吝的老流氓，家里还有个同他一样的混蛋儿子，怎么能让徐喜弟单枪匹马过去呢？他必须去给她撑腰。……徐喜弟拿了钱就直奔赵丁家。她本来想拉刘宇宁过去的，但是王秀菊肯定不让他淌这浑水，所以就算了。刘烨，这会儿还在小羊山开荒呢，至少要天黑才回来。手里拿着钱，她也不能拿回家，否则说不定就让范金花和张国海给顺了。赵丁家在村尾，平时做人横行又混蛋，村里人也不爱招惹他。他家盖的房子，围菜园子，就占了别人的地，人家都没敢吭声。所以他家是一大片院子。走到院门口，她刚推开门，就听见屋里有不一样的动静。村尾比较偏，又在半山腰，跟前面一户人家隔了好一段距离。平常没什么人来，她突然进门，所以听到了不一样的。“你快点……”“竟然嫌我慢？你家老李能有这劲？”“别提他，让我守活寡二十年了。”徐喜弟脚步一顿，这声音，不是那个李家婶子吗？每次跟别人咬耳朵咬得最欢，背着她不知道说了她多少难听的话。原来就是这么个东西！好极了！今天就抓个现行，看这个老妇女以后还跟别人嚼舌根说自己坏话不！“行了，你守他的活寡，我补偿你就是了。”“哼，还补偿呢，要不是你家那个死了，我一个月都见不到你几回……”“所以她才死了嘛，病那么多年，干耗着我。还是你好……”“那你前几天，哄人家巴儿姐钻牛棚，又是怎么回事？嫌我老了，找年轻的？”“她呀……一个智障，你也跟她比？”“那你还给五十块了，我可是一分都没见过！”“别说话，我快来了啊~”徐喜弟静静站在堂屋门口，心想时候到了。她抬起脚，正准备踹门，就被人从身后拉住。咔嚓呀~吓死人了~她抬头一看，刘宇宁一米二的大长腿已经蹬了出去。哐当一声，堂屋的大门摇摇欲坠。也不给屋里的人反应，两人直奔赵丁的房门，刘宇宁又一个蹬腿。房门没关，嘭一声门板打在墙上。床上的两人吓的蹦起来。“李家婶子，你怎么在赵丁屋里啊？”徐喜弟假装惊讶。“怎么又是你们？”赵丁跳下床，捡起裤子就胡乱套上。刘宇宁大手一拉，把徐喜弟拉到自己的背后，用身体挡住她快要瞪出眼珠子的视线。李家婶子脸皮没有这么糙，拉起被子就把自己的头蒙住。“婶子，你别躲了，我们都看见你了。”徐喜弟躲在刘宇宁的背后，讥诮地喊话。“你们两个活腻了，敢冲到我家里来！”赵丁穿上裤子，就开始凶狠地叫嚣。“我们不来，怎么撞你们俩的丑事？还敢编排我家，我今天也给你们宣传宣传！”徐喜弟从刘宇宁背后站出来，从裤兜里掏出那五十块，就往赵丁脸上砸去。“拿你的臭钱回去吧！我们张家，不卖皮肉！你给里家婶子吧！”被子里的李婶（简称），忽然掀开被子，呜呜哭起来。“我，我是被迫的！”如果让徐喜弟上村里宣传，自己回家指定要被老李打死。所以她必须甩锅。“你说什么？！”赵丁还没从脸上的五十块钱中回过神，听见李婶这么说，他怒了。“你给老子再说一遍？”“我强迫你这种老皮nang？！”刘宇宁看他想动手，冲上去三两下就把人死死按在地上。“三番两次干这种见不得人的事，还想动手？”“我~我没要动手，我就是想骂她！”赵丁脸着地，还是强撑着狡辩。李婶被他说得眼皮直跳，可是比起和赵丁闹翻，她更怕回家被打死。“宇宁，你们看，他这么凶。我就是来他家借把镰刀的……”“借什么镰刀，能借到屋里，借到床上去？”徐喜弟冷哼一声。“李婶，我在门口可是听得一清二楚，你俩都来往二十年了，之前都不强迫，今天撞见了才说强迫？”徐喜弟好不容易抓着一个机会，怎么可能让李婶轻易逃脱。喜欢嚼人口舌，说人是非是吧，这回轮到她尝一尝什么叫身败名裂！“不管是不是强迫，这种非正当的行为，就该报公安，让公安来评断。”刘宇宁可没什么心情跟他们在这里扯闲篇。他再次抽出赵丁的裤腰带，轻松就把人反剪绑了。然后又从旁边扯了一条绳子，扔给徐喜弟。“我在门口等，这两人都要绑了去见大队长。”说完，他把赵丁提溜起来，扭到门外等待。徐喜弟第二次见证刘宇宁快如雷霆闪电的身手，心里都是崇拜。这样的男人，简直太太太厉害了吧！人长得又好看！“婶，你还是穿上衣服吧，同是女人，我也不想这么裸着绑你，不好看，丢人。”李婶撇着嘴，脸上全是慌乱。虽然现在不流行批斗了，可是她和赵丁一起被绑着送到大队去，也是说不清的呀！“喜弟，婶求你，留个体面，别绑了行吗？我真是被迫的……”徐喜弟不为所动，这些老妇女，平日就爱叭叭别人，这时候为了保住自己名声，更是瞎说八道。“我不绑着，你路上跑了，不等于我和宇宁哥平白诬陷赵丁那个老流氓了吗？”“正好，今天给他抓了个正着，多罪一起论，能让他多关几年。至于李婶你嘛，自做虐，怪不了我。”徐喜弟拿着绳子，等李婶衣服穿差不多，扣子还没扣全，就给她捆了起来。衣服凌乱些，才更有说服力！
content_en: "Son, just by checking the check box on the IOU, she can acknowledge the debt?" This was also the first time Wang Xiuju heard about it."Well, she accepts it and I accept it, that's enough. It doesn't matter whether you check it or circle it." Liu Yuning put the 'note' into his trouser pocket."Keep the note for me. You go out to work. Don't forget it when the time comes. After washing it, the fifty yuan will be wasted." "I'll keep it myself. She borrowed it from me. I'll ask her for it myself." Liu Yuning raised the corner of his mouth, gave Wang Xiuju the pen and paper, and then went out.Zhao Ding is an old gangster who doesn't hesitate to do anything. He also has a son who is as bastard as him at home. How can he let Xu Xidi go there alone?He had to support her....Xu Xidi took the money and went straight to Zhao Ding's house.She originally wanted to drag Liu Yuning over, but Wang Xiuju definitely wouldn't let him get into this muddy water, so she let it go.Liu Ye is still opening up wasteland in Xiaoyang Mountain at the moment and will not come back until dark at least.With the money in her hand, she couldn't take it home, otherwise she might let Fan Jinhua and Zhang Guohai go along with it.Zhao Ding's family is at the end of the village. He is usually a rampant and a jerk, and people in the village don't like to mess with him.The house his family built and surrounded by a vegetable garden occupied other people's land, and they didn't dare to say anything.So his house is a large yard.When she reached the door of the courtyard, as soon as she opened the door, she heard something different in the room.The end of the village is relatively remote, halfway up the mountain, and is quite a distance away from the house in front.Normally no one comes, but she suddenly walked in, so she heard something different."Hurry up..." "You think I'm slow? How can your old Li be so energetic?" "Don't mention him, I've been a widow for twenty years." Xu Xidi paused in his steps. Isn't this voice from the Li family's aunt?I have the most fun every time I bite someone's ear, and I don't know how many unpleasant things I have said about her behind her back.It turns out that’s what it is!Great!Let's catch it today and see if this old woman will talk bad about herself to others in the future!"Okay, you stay as his widow, and I'll just make it up to you." "Humph, I'll make it up to you. If your wife hadn't died, I wouldn't have been able to see you a few times a month..." "That's why she died. She's been sick for so many years, and it's been a waste of time for me. It's better for you..." "Then you were coaxing me a few days ago.What's the matter with my sister going to the bullpen?You think I'm old and you're looking for someone younger?" "She's...a retarded person.How can you compete with her?" "Then you gave me fifty yuan, but I haven't seen a cent!" "Stop talking, I'm coming soon~" Xu Xidi stood quietly at the door of the main room, thinking that the time has come.She raised her foot and was about to kick the door when she was pulled from behind.Click~ It was so scary~ She looked up and saw that Liu Yuning's one-meter-two long legs had already kicked out.There was a clang, and the door of the hall shook.Without giving any reaction to the people in the room, the two of them went straight to Zhao Ding's door, and Liu Yuning kicked his legs again.The door was not closed, and the door panel hit the wall with a bang.The two people on the bed jumped up in fright."Aunt Li, why are you in Zhao Ding's house?" Xu Xidi pretended to be surprised."Why is it you again?" Zhao Ding jumped out of bed, picked up his pants and put them on haphazardly.Liu Yuning pulled Xu Xidi behind him with a big hand, and used his body to block her gaze that was about to pop out of her eyes.Aunt Li's face was not so rough, so she pulled up the quilt and covered her head."Auntie, stop hiding, we have all seen you." Xu Xidi hid behind Liu Yuning and shouted sarcastically."You two are tired of living, how dare you come to my house!" Zhao Ding put on his pants and started shouting fiercely."If we don't come, how can we cause scandal for you two? How dare you arrange my family, and I will publicize it for you today!" Xu Xidi stood up from behind Liu Yuning, took out the fifty yuan from his trouser pocket, and threw it at Zhao Ding's face."Take your dirty money and go back! Our Zhang family doesn't sell skin and flesh! Give it to my aunt from home!" Aunt Li (abbreviation) in the quilt suddenly opened the quilt and started to cry."I, I was forced!" If Xu Xidi was allowed to go to the village to promote the truth, he would be beaten to death by Lao Li when he returned home.So she has to take the blame."What did you say?!" Zhao Ding had not recovered from the fifty yuan on his face. When he heard Aunt Li say this, he became angry."You're going to tell me again?" "I'm forcing you, an old skinny like you?!" Liu Yuning saw that he was about to make a move, so he rushed forward and pinned the man to the ground in a few seconds."You've done such shameful things over and over again, and you still want to take action?" "I~I don't want to take action, I just want to scold her!" Zhao Ding fell to the ground with his face on the ground, still holding on to his quibbles.Aunt Li's eyelids jumped at what he said, but she was more afraid of being beaten to death when she went home than falling out with Zhao Ding."Yuning, look, he is so cruel. I just came to his house to borrow a sickle..." "What kind of sickle can I borrow in the house or on the bed?" Xu Xidi snorted coldly."Aunt Li, I heard you clearly at the door. You two have been together for twenty years. You didn't force yourself before. But today we bumped into each other and you said force?" Xu Xidi finally grasped an opportunity. How could he let Aunt Li escape so easily?She likes to gossip and talk about people's rights and wrongs. This time it's her turn to taste what it means to be ruined!"Whether it's forced or not, this kind of illegal behavior should be reported to the police and let them judge." Liu Yuning was not in the mood to chat with them here.He pulled out Zhao Ding's waistband again and easily tied him up.Then he pulled a rope from the side and threw it to Xu Xidi."I'll wait at the door. These two people have to be tied up to see the captain." After saying that, he slipped Zhao Dingti up and twisted outside the door to wait.Xu Xidi witnessed Liu Yuning's lightning-fast skills for the second time, and he was full of admiration in his heart.Such a man is simply too powerful!He is so good-looking!"Aunt, you'd better put on some clothes. We're both women, and I don't want to tie you up naked like this. It's not good-looking and embarrassing." Aunt Li pouted, her face full of panic.Although it is no longer popular to criticize and fight, it is still inexplicable that she and Zhao Ding were tied up and sent to the brigade!"Brother Xi, please, please have some dignity and don't tie me up, okay? I'm really forced..." Xu Xidi was unmoved. These old women usually love to gossip about others, but now they are talking nonsense in order to protect their own reputation."If I don't tie you up, and you ran away on the road, doesn't it mean that Brother Yuning and I framed that old gangster Zhao Ding for nothing?" "It just so happens that he was caught today and tried for multiple crimes together, so he can be imprisoned for a few more years. As for Aunt Li, you can't blame me for the abuse you committed." Xu Xidi took the rope and tied Aunt Li up after she had almost finished wearing her clothes and not all the buttons were buttoned.The more messy your clothes are, the more convincing you will be!
